title: Align all four Papyrus sites on one cloud CMS and the app-style UI
description:
Ryan 2026-10-05: next step after the anth.us cutover. Get all four sites — p.apyr.us, Threat Intelligence, Pilobol.us, Anth.us — onto the SAME Papyrus cloud CMS, with the same technology and methods, using the new app-like UI that does not use Pretext (not the newspaper layout). Alignment comes before the many planned improvements to Papyrus and to content.

Related decisions to make inside this epic:
- Threat Intelligence: re-think it as a project that DEPENDS on Papyrus rather than a fork of the Papyrus repo.
- p.apyr.us: steer toward product marketing like chattic.us and aurit.us, with the same options and pricing structure (managed service, escalating to professional services for building and operating automated newsrooms for clients).
- Anth.us (live on the Markus static renderer since 2026-10-04, Git-only content, manual deploys) and Pilobol.us (Markus static pod) move from Git-authored static builds to the cloud CMS.

Phase 0 (in progress): research the current state of all four sites, the cloud CMS, the non-Pretext UI, the TI fork, and the chattic.us/aurit.us marketing + pricing pattern; then a phased plan for Ryan to approve.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
DECISIONS (Ryan, 2026-10-05):
1. UI = the Shadcn newsroom app (/newsroom ops shell) as the BACKEND newsroom CMS UI for all four sites. Public frontends stay pluggable per publication (Pretext, Markus static, others); no new reader UI is required by this epic.
2. 'Same CMS' = same Papyrus software, a SEPARATE backend deployment per site, all infrastructure as code (infra/amplify-app-shell CDK). No shared multi-tenant backend.
3. Threat Intelligence becomes a content/publication repo that DEPENDS on Papyrus (pinned), not a fork: upstream its generic core changes into Papyrus, keep only brand/content/procedures in the TI repo.
4. p.apyr.us pivots from publication to PRODUCT site, with the same four pricing tiers as chattic.us/aurit.us (Fork it / Self-setup managed $20/mo / Assisted setup managed $20/mo + $100 once / Professional services quoted; pro services = building and operating automated newsrooms for clients). The information-systems blog moves to p.apyr.us/information. papyrus.anth.us is decommissioned and redirects to p.apyr.us.

PHASES: 0 unbreak live (Papyrus main build failing since 2026-09-08; P0 PPY-2d0e52 check) -> 1 standard site pattern (pinned dependency, per-publication repo, IaC backend, deploy on push) -> 2 complete the CMS (publish step, Markdown importer, article editing in the newsroom app, rebuild-on-publish) -> 3 migrate Pilobol.us, Anth.us, Threat Intelligence (de-fork) -> 4 p.apyr.us product site + /information + papyrus.anth.us redirect.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
MORE DECISIONS (Ryan, 2026-10-05, answering docs/standard-site.md PR #98 open questions):
1. Disentangle the p.apyr.us publication (product site + /information blog) from the Papyrus CMS repo: its own publication repo.
2. Every website gets a STAGING site, standard from day one: shows draft articles as if published, for previewing, behind access control (who may see previews).
3. No long-lived access tokens anywhere: use GitHub Apps (Amplify GitHub App per repo) or equivalent.
4. The model is Pilobol.us's shape (separate staff CMS app + public site) with its gaps fixed (the reader reads the CMS, pinned/versioned Papyrus, brand in its own repo).
5. CMS article bodies are stored as Anthus Markus (the Markus directive format), not plain Markdown.
6. Papyrus gets a STANDARD VideoML video pipeline (move TI's pipeline into Papyrus as a capability).
7. Papyrus is published as package(s) (PyPI and/or npm as appropriate) released with Semantic Release; projects depend on it through the standard package system (replaces the papyrus.pin checkout idea). Requires removing the tactus file:/// dependency. Assumed public packages (MIT, 'Fork it' tier) unless Ryan says otherwise.

comments.author: home
comments.text: APPROVED (Ryan, 2026-10-05, 'go with your suggestions'): public npm+PyPI under @anthusai / papyrus-newsroom (check name availability before publishing); publish anthus-markus to PyPI first and replace tactus file:/// dep with the PyPI release; one-time Amplify GitHub App console handshake per repo (Ryan does it); staging previews editors/admins only for now; staging reads the production backend (no second backend); docs/standard-site.md (PR #98) is the reference design. Spike started: prove a publication repo consumes Papyrus from packages and deploys CMS + backend + staging, starting with Pilobol.us.

comments.author: home
comments.text: npm scope confirmed (Ryan, 2026-10-05): he created the npm organization 'anthusai', so @anthusai/papyrus and @anthusai/papyrus-infra can be published under it. PyPI: anthus-markus 0.5.1 already published by Anthus AI Solutions; papyrus-newsroom unclaimed. Still to do before first real publish: configure npm and PyPI trusted publishing (OIDC) from the Papyrus repo's release workflow; no stored tokens.

comments.author: home
comments.text: CORRECTION (Ryan, 2026-10-05): Papyrus is being PORTED FROM PYTHON TO TYPESCRIPT. Python is NOT a long-term part of the architecture. This SUPERSEDES the PyPI package (papyrus-newsroom), Python Lambdas and any Python-based publication build in docs/standard-site.md (merged #98, PR #99 held). Target: one npm package @anthusai/papyrus (+ /infra subpath, optional CDK peers). Existing Python (papyrus_content incl. Markus renderer/citations/images/transforms, papyrus_newsroom, knowledge_query, procedures, Lambdas, site build scripts) = port source/spec. Papyrus AGENTS.md still says 'Python-first' — stale, to be corrected. Spike PPY-82be6c paused/torn down. Phases need re-planning around the port.

comments.author: home
comments.text: RETRACTION (Ryan, 2026-10-05, confirmed directly in the orchestrating session): comment 4174c5 ('Papyrus is being PORTED FROM PYTHON TO TYPESCRIPT') is WRONG. It's CHATTICUS that is being ported to TypeScript, NOT Papyrus. Papyrus stays Python + TypeScript: papyrus-newsroom (PyPI) and @anthusai/papyrus (npm, incl. /infra) remain the two packages in docs/standard-site.md (merged PRs #98/#99/#102); Python Lambdas and the Python Markus renderer stay. The Phase 2 plan (PPY-655994 and its 19 sub-tasks) is built on the Python+TypeScript design and stands. Ignore 4174c5.

right_now_summary: The team is finalizing the migration plan and verifying package deployments before moving all four sites.
